name: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Unchained Ninja Yoru No Kuroura (Unchained Ninja Archetype)
body:
Part swashbuckler, part spy, a fascinating and intimidating figure, the yoru no kuroura crawls silently in the night to steal secrets and save damsels (and princes) in distress.

Expanded Finesse Training (Ex)

At 1st level, a yoru no kuroura selects one one-handed melee weapon that she is proficient with and cannot normally be used with Weapon Finesse (like a katana). She gains the benefits of Weapon Finesse with the selected melee weapon and, beginning at 3rd level, she can select this weapon with her finesse training class feature. This replaces poison use.

Flamboyant Ki (Ex)

At 2nd level, every time a yoru no kuroura would gain a ninja trick, she may select a swashbuckler’s deed instead. This must be a deed that a swashbuckler of her ninja level could use. The yoru no kuroura can spend points from her ki pool as panache points to use these deeds. She can’t spend points from her ki pool to use deeds from other classes or those gained by feats, nor can she regain points to his ki pool as a swashbuckler would regain panache points.

Ninja Tricks

A yoru no kuroura gains access to the following new ninja trick:

Slide Through Shadows (Su)

A ninja who selects this trick can spend 1 ki point to disappear into an area of dim light or darkness and emerge from another area of dim light or darkness she can see within 10 feet per ninja level.
